Unlock PDF

Remove passwords from PDFs you own.

Enter the password once and Paperly decrypts the file locally, returning an identical PDF without restrictions.

Processed entirely in your browser. Your file is not uploaded, stored or retained by Paperly.

How Unlock PDF works

  1. Add the protected PDF.
  2. Enter its password — it’s checked in your browser only.
  3. Download the unlocked, unencrypted PDF.

Limitations

Results depend on the input document. Always keep the original file until you have verified the output.
